name: Question 4
problem: Given the function $f(x,y,z)={x}^{2}y+{y}^{2}-xz$,  find the equation of the tangent plane to the level surface that passes through the point where $(x,y,z)=(2,-1,-1).$
worked_solution:
The equation of the tangent plane to the level surface $f(x,y,z)=k$ at the point $({x}_{0},{y}_{0},{z}_{0})$ can be expressed as

$$
∇f({x}_{0},{y}_{0},{z}_{0})\cdot ⟨x-{x}_{0},\,y-{y}_{0},\,z-{z}_{0}⟩=0.
$$

First, we find the gradient of $f(x,y,z)$ and evaluate it at $({x}_{0},{y}_{0},{z}_{0})=(2,-1,-1):$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}∇\,f(x,y,z) & ={f}_{x}(x,y,z)\,i+{f}_{y}(x,y,z)\,j+{f}_{z}(x,y,z)\,k \\  & =\frac{∂}{∂x}({x}^{2}y+{y}^{2}-xz)\text{ }i+\frac{∂}{∂y}({x}^{2}y+{y}^{2}-xz)\text{ }j+\frac{∂}{∂z}({x}^{2}y+{y}^{2}-xz)\text{ }k \\  & =(2xy-z)\text{ }i+({x}^{2}+2y)\text{ }j-xk \\ ∇\,f(2,-1,-1) & =(\,2(2)(-1)-(-1)\,)\text{ }i+(\,{2}^{2}+2(-1)\,)\text{ }j-2k \\  & =-3\,i+2\,j-2\,k \\  & =⟨-3,2,-2⟩\end{aligned}
$$

We can now write down the Cartesian equation of the tangent plane to the level surface, as follows: 

$$
\begin{aligned}∇f({x}_{0},{y}_{0},{z}_{0})\cdot ⟨x-{x}_{0},\,y-{y}_{0},\,z-{z}_{0}⟩ & =0 \\ ∇f(2,-1,-1)\cdot ⟨x-2,\,y+1,\,z+1⟩ & =0 \\ ⟨-3,2,-2⟩\cdot ⟨x-2,\,y+1,\,z+1⟩ & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Question 4
?

Given the function f(x,y,z)=x2y+y2−xz, find the equation of the tangent plane to the level surface that passes through the point where (x,y,z)=(2,−1,−1).

a
⟨3,2,2⟩⋅⟨x+2,y+1,z+1⟩=0
b
⟨2,−3,−2⟩⋅⟨x−2,y+1,z+1⟩=0
c
⟨−3,2,−2⟩⋅⟨x−3,y+2,z−2⟩=0
d
⟨2,−3,2⟩⋅⟨x+2,y+1,z+1⟩=0
e
⟨−3,2,−2⟩⋅⟨x−2,y+1,z+1⟩=0
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

The equation of the tangent plane to the level surface f(x,y,z)=k at the point (x0,y0,z0) can be expressed as

∇f(x0,y0,z0)⋅⟨x−x0,y−y0,z−z0⟩=0.

First, we find the gradient of f(x,y,z) and evaluate it at (x0,y0,z0)=(2,−1,−1):

∇f(x,y,z)=fx(x,y,z)i+fy(x,y,z)j+fz(x,y,z)k=∂∂x(x2y+y2−xz) i+∂∂y(x2y+y2−xz) j+∂∂z(x2y+y2−xz) k=(2xy−z) i+(x2+2y) j−xk∇f(2,−1,−1)=(2(2)(−1)−(−1)) i+(22+2(−1)) j−2k=−3i+2j−2k=⟨−3,2,−2⟩

We can now write down the Cartesian equation of the tangent plane to the level surface, as follows:

∇f(x0,y0,z0)⋅⟨x−x0,y−y0,z−z0⟩=0∇f(2,−1,−1)⋅⟨x−2,y+1,z+1⟩=0⟨−3,2,−2⟩⋅⟨x−2,y+1,z+1⟩=0
